q: how do I make the letters bigger on my screen
answer: <lang en>Open Settings, then Accessibility, then Text size on the left. Move the size slider to the right until the letters look good, then press Apply.

answer: <lang en><mood calm> A browser is a program that opens websites for you. You type what you want to find, and it shows the pages.

q: is it safe to save my passwords in the computer
answer: <lang en><mood calm>Saving passwords in your browser is usually okay for everyday sites. For email and banking it is safer to type them each time, and never share them with anyone.

q: what is the cloud exactly
answer: <lang en>The cloud means your files are kept safely on the internet, not only on this computer. You can open them from anywhere when you are connected.

q: how do I copy and paste something
answer: <lang en>First choose the words you want, then hold Control and press C to copy. Then go to the new place, and hold Control and press V to put it there.

q: why does my phone battery die so fast
answer: <lang en><mood calm>Many small things use power all day, like a bright screen and apps left open. Try making the screen less bright and closing apps you do not use. Would you like me to go on with more easy tips?

q: how do I turn the Wi-Fi on
answer: <lang en>Press the Windows key and the letter I together to open Settings. Go to Network and internet, then Wi-Fi. Turn the Wi-Fi switch to On.

q: what is an app
answer: <lang en><mood calm>An app is a small program on your computer that does one job. For example Mail sends letters, and Photos keeps pictures.

q: how do I update Windows
answer: <lang en>Open Start at the bottom and choose Settings. Then choose Windows Update on the left and choose Check for updates. If it offers an update choose Download and install and wait while it finishes.

answer: <lang en><mood calm>Sorry to hear it is slow, that is frustrating. A restart often helps a lot, so turn it off and on again first. Shall we check step by step together?

q: what is the difference between a text message and an email
answer: <lang en>A text message is a short note sent to a phone number, and it arrives very fast. An email is like a longer letter sent to an email address, and it is better for photos and papers.

q: how do I move a photo from my phone to the computer
answer: <lang en><mood calm>Plug your phone into the computer with its charging cable. Then open Files and look for your phone name on the left side. Say show me if you want me to look with you.

q: what does download mean
answer: <lang en>Download means to bring a file from the internet onto this computer, like saving a photo so you can keep it.
